content.text:
I fixed the contact page. The form fields had lost the space between them, so the labels and inputs were crammed together.

The cause was in `site/css/components.css`. `.form-field` had `margin-bottom: 0`, where it needs `var(--space-4)`, which is 16px. Five fields at 16px each is the 80px the page had shrunk by. Only the contact form uses `.form-field`, so no other page is affected.

I re-ran the visual tests and all 12 snapshots, desktop and phone, now match the existing baselines. I didn't approve or change any baselines. The functional tests also pass, 16 of 16.

The `.idea` and `.vscode` folders showing as untracked in git were already there. I didn't create them and haven't touched them.

STATUS: DONE
